description: This file defines functions and types for discovering and parsing models from the Kilo Gateway API, including static fallback mechanisms, and handles model pricing conversions and schema definitions.

methods.name: toPricePerMillion
methods.description: Converts per-token price string to per-1M-token number.

methods.name: parseModality
methods.description: Determines input modalities (text/image) from model entry.

methods.name: parseReasoning
methods.description: Checks if model supports reasoning parameters.

methods.name: toModelDefinition
methods.description: Converts a GatewayModelEntry to a ModelDefinitionConfig object.

methods.name: buildStaticCatalog
methods.description: Builds a static list of model definitions from a catalog.

methods.name: discoverKilocodeModels
methods.description: Discovers models from API with fallback to static catalog.
